Authentic sushi, no gimmicks.
Aug 2015 • Solo
The restaurant is owned by Japanese folks, so I'm told, and the chefs were trained in and by Japanese sushi chefs. They have an extensive menu that covers sushi, sashimi, tempura, and ramen. 

The sushi is fresh and much of it is imported from Japan daily. Tuna, salmon, yellowtail, scallops, it's all wonderful. I recommend asking the chef to serve you what he enjoys making or thinks is best that day. You can't go wrong. However, you should try the maguro yukke (spicy tuna salad). It's amazing. 

I had wonderful service and I won't hesitate to go back. Do let them know if you want to sit in a non-smoking area as I believe they accommodate for smokers.

Good food, good service
Apr 2015 • Family
We have been to a lot of places offering sushi in Hochiminh city. However, this is one of our favorite thanks to the nice restaurant setting located next to a luxurious apartment building and good staff service. The staff are so friendly and courteous. They are such polite people, although most of Japanese restaurants have the same quality, but here they provide us with a warm feeling, some place like home. Food is quite good, and is cooked in a short time, We dont have to wait for long. If you are from 6 people, ask them to sit with special table in the corner, having a tree in the middle, a funny experience.
I do come back for sure.

One of the best Jap foods in HCMC
Dec 2013 • Couples
One way to tell if a Japanese restaurant is authentic and up to standard is the number of Japanese customers it has. When we were there, at least 50% of the tables were filled by Japanese.

We were there for their New Year promotion which ended on 31 Dec 2013. The price was unbelievable - around 499,000vnd for 2 persons... that's less than 12usd per person!!

Somen - this starter was deliciously sweet and refreshing
Salmon - fresh and grilled perfectly
Wagyu - omg it really melts in your mouth
Shabu shabu - we were very full by this last dish but we can't stop having it!
